items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Topics 30:1
items.html: Since the inner Aba and Ima were hidden, therefore the ascent of ZA to AA is considered only VAK of Chaya. And therefore these Mochin helped only to raise the four upper [Sefirot] of Yetzirah to Atzilut, but not its seven lower [Sefirot]. For the seven lower [Sefirot] of Yetzirah, which are the aspect of a body, need the aspect of the GAR of Chaya, which are bestowed from above downward; but the VAK of Chaya are received only from the aspect of from below upward alone. (Item 56).
